prompt: She ___ to work by bus every day.
explain_en: Third person singular in the present simple takes '-s': she goes.
explain_hi: Present simple में third person singular के साथ '-s' लगता है: she goes।

prompt: ___ an engineer.
explain_en: The verb 'be' with 'I' is 'am': I am.
explain_hi: 'I' के साथ 'be' का रूप 'am' होता है: I am।

prompt: There is ___ apple on the table.
explain_en: 'Apple' starts with a vowel sound, so we use 'an'.
explain_hi: 'Apple' vowel ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए 'an' का प्रयोग होता है।

prompt: I'm tired. I want to ___.
explain_en: When you are tired, you want to sleep.
explain_hi: जब आप थके होते हैं, तो आप सोना चाहते हैं (sleep)।

prompt: They ___ my friends.
explain_en: The verb 'be' with 'they' is 'are'.
explain_hi: 'They' के साथ 'be' का रूप 'are' होता है।

prompt: ___ you like tea?
explain_en: Present simple questions with 'you' use 'Do': Do you like...?
explain_hi: 'You' के साथ present simple प्रश्न में 'Do' आता है: Do you like...?

prompt: My brother is a doctor. He works in a ___.
explain_en: A doctor works in a hospital.
explain_hi: एक doctor hospital में काम करता है।

prompt: This is my book. ___ name is on it.
explain_en: 'My' is the possessive adjective before a noun: My name.
explain_hi: किसी noun से पहले possessive adjective 'My' आता है: My name।

prompt: We ___ not at home now.
explain_en: 'We' takes 'are': We are not at home.
explain_hi: 'We' के साथ 'are' आता है: We are not at home।

prompt: It's cold. Please close the ___.
explain_en: You close a window to keep the cold out.
explain_hi: ठंड रोकने के लिए आप window बंद करते हैं।

prompt: He ___ have a car.
explain_en: Third person negative in present simple uses 'doesn't': He doesn't have.
explain_hi: Third person negative में 'doesn't' आता है: He doesn't have।

prompt: 'How are you?' — '___'
explain_en: 'How are you?' asks about your state; the natural reply is 'I'm fine, thanks.'
explain_hi: 'How are you?' आपकी स्थिति पूछता है; स्वाभाविक जवाब है 'I'm fine, thanks.'

prompt: Yesterday I ___ to the market.
explain_en: 'Yesterday' needs the past simple; the past of 'go' is 'went'.
explain_hi: 'Yesterday' के साथ past simple चाहिए; 'go' का past 'went' है।

prompt: How ___ water do you drink every day?
explain_en: 'Water' is uncountable, so we use 'much'.
explain_hi: 'Water' uncountable है, इसलिए 'much' का प्रयोग होता है।

prompt: This bag is ___ than that one.
explain_en: Short adjectives form the comparative with '-er': heavier.
explain_hi: छोटे adjectives comparative में '-er' लेते हैं: heavier।

prompt: I didn't ___ him at the party.
explain_en: After 'didn't' we use the base verb: didn't see.
explain_hi: 'didn't' के बाद base verb आता है: didn't see।

prompt: She was ___ because she failed the exam.
explain_en: Failing an exam makes someone sad.
explain_hi: परीक्षा में असफल होने से कोई sad हो जाता है।

prompt: There aren't ___ chairs in the room.
explain_en: In negatives with countable plurals we use 'any': aren't any chairs.
explain_hi: Negative में countable plurals के साथ 'any' आता है: aren't any chairs।

prompt: We ___ going to visit my uncle next week.
explain_en: 'be going to' with 'we' uses 'are': we are going to visit.
explain_hi: 'we' के साथ 'be going to' में 'are' आता है: we are going to visit।

prompt: Turn ___ the light, please. It's dark.
explain_en: 'Turn on' a light to make it work; the room is dark.
explain_hi: अँधेरा है, इसलिए light 'turn on' करते हैं।

prompt: He is good ___ playing the guitar.
explain_en: The fixed phrase is 'good at' something.
explain_hi: निश्चित वाक्यांश है 'good at' किसी चीज़ में।

prompt: I ___ TV when the phone rang.
explain_en: A longer background action uses the past continuous: was watching.
explain_hi: लंबी background क्रिया के लिए past continuous: was watching।

prompt: The film was very ___. I nearly fell asleep.
explain_en: A thing that causes boredom is 'boring'; the '-ing' form describes the film.
explain_hi: जो चीज़ ऊब पैदा करती है वह 'boring' है; '-ing' रूप फ़िल्म का वर्णन करता है।

prompt: 'Would you like some tea?' — '___'
explain_en: The natural short reply to an offer is 'Yes, please.'
explain_hi: किसी offer का स्वाभाविक छोटा जवाब है 'Yes, please.'

prompt: I ___ in Ahmedabad for ten years. I still live here.
explain_en: An action that started in the past and continues uses the present perfect: have lived.
explain_hi: जो क्रिया अतीत में शुरू होकर अब भी जारी है, उसके लिए present perfect: have lived।

prompt: If it rains tomorrow, we ___ the trip.
explain_en: First conditional: 'if' + present simple, then 'will' + base verb.
explain_hi: First conditional: 'if' + present simple, फिर 'will' + base verb।

prompt: She avoided ___ the question directly.
explain_en: 'Avoid' is followed by the '-ing' form: avoided answering.
explain_hi: 'Avoid' के बाद '-ing' रूप आता है: avoided answering।

prompt: Do you know where ___?
explain_en: In an embedded question the word order is subject + verb: where the station is.
explain_hi: Embedded question में शब्द-क्रम subject + verb होता है: where the station is।

prompt: I have known him ___ 2015.
explain_en: 'Since' is used with a point in time: since 2015.
explain_hi: 'Since' किसी समय-बिंदु के साथ आता है: since 2015।

prompt: Have you finished the report ___?
explain_en: In present perfect questions we use 'yet' at the end: finished ... yet?
explain_hi: Present perfect प्रश्नों में अंत में 'yet' आता है: finished ... yet?

prompt: The company decided to ___ the meeting because the manager was ill.
explain_en: 'Put off' means to postpone; the meeting was moved to a later time.
explain_hi: 'Put off' का अर्थ है स्थगित करना; meeting बाद के लिए टाल दी गई।

prompt: If I ___ more time, I would learn another language.
explain_en: Second conditional (imaginary): 'if' + past simple, then 'would' + base verb.
explain_hi: Second conditional (काल्पनिक): 'if' + past simple, फिर 'would' + base verb।

prompt: We need to ___ this bug before the release.
explain_en: After 'need to' we use the base verb: need to fix.
explain_hi: 'need to' के बाद base verb आता है: need to fix।

prompt: The bag ___ by the police at the airport.
explain_en: Passive past simple: was + past participle: was checked.
explain_hi: Passive past simple: was + past participle: was checked।

prompt: Which sentence is correct?
explain_en: 'Have' for states is not used in the continuous: 'I have a headache.'
explain_hi: अवस्था के लिए 'have' continuous में नहीं आता: 'I have a headache.'

prompt: This is the colleague ___ helped me with the report.
explain_en: For a person who is the subject of the clause we use 'who'.
explain_hi: जो व्यक्ति clause का subject है, उसके लिए 'who' आता है।

prompt: If I had known about the risk, I ___ the update.
explain_en: Third conditional: 'if' + past perfect, then 'would have' + past participle.
explain_hi: Third conditional: 'if' + past perfect, फिर 'would have' + past participle।

prompt: He said that he ___ the email the day before.
explain_en: In reported speech, a past action shifts to the past perfect: had sent.
explain_hi: Reported speech में पिछली क्रिया past perfect में बदलती है: had sent।

prompt: The evidence was weak, so his argument was rather ___.
explain_en: 'Tenuous' means weak or flimsy, matching weak evidence.
explain_hi: 'Tenuous' का अर्थ है कमज़ोर, जो weak evidence से मेल खाता है।

prompt: It's high time we ___ this problem seriously.
explain_en: 'It's high time' is followed by the past simple to talk about the present: we took.
explain_hi: 'It's high time' के बाद वर्तमान के लिए past simple आता है: we took।

prompt: The report needs ___ before we send it.
explain_en: 'Need + -ing' has a passive meaning: the report needs reviewing (needs to be reviewed).
explain_hi: 'Need + -ing' का अर्थ passive होता है: needs reviewing (needs to be reviewed)।

prompt: We couldn't reproduce the issue, ___ the report was closed.
explain_en: 'Hence' introduces a result: we couldn't reproduce it, hence it was closed.
explain_hi: 'Hence' परिणाम बताता है: reproduce नहीं हुआ, इसलिए बंद कर दिया।

prompt: I'd rather you ___ the client directly next time.
explain_en: 'I'd rather you' is followed by the past simple for a preference about another person: contacted.
explain_hi: 'I'd rather you' के बाद दूसरे व्यक्ति की पसंद के लिए past simple: contacted।

prompt: The two teams have ___ responsibility for the fix, so no one is sure who owns it.
explain_en: 'Overlapping' responsibility explains the confusion about ownership.
explain_hi: 'Overlapping' ज़िम्मेदारी से ownership की उलझन समझ आती है।

prompt: ___ the deadline, the team stayed calm and delivered on time.
explain_en: 'Despite' + noun phrase shows contrast: despite the deadline.
explain_hi: 'Despite' + noun phrase विरोध दिखाता है: despite the deadline।

prompt: Please ___ the issue to the senior team if it isn't resolved in an hour.
explain_en: In work contexts you 'escalate' an unresolved issue to a higher level.
explain_hi: काम में अनसुलझी समस्या को उच्च स्तर पर 'escalate' किया जाता है।

prompt: By the time we arrived, the meeting ___.
explain_en: An action completed before another past action uses the past perfect: had started.
explain_hi: किसी दूसरी पिछली क्रिया से पहले पूरी हुई क्रिया के लिए past perfect: had started।

prompt: Which is the most natural, polite way to disagree in a meeting?
options: That's a fair point, but I see it differently.
I don't agree with you at all, obviously.
explain_en: Acknowledging then softening ('a fair point, but...') is polite and professional.
explain_hi: पहले मानना फिर नरमी से असहमति ('a fair point, but...') विनम्र और professional है।

prompt: Not only ___ the deadline, but he also improved the design.
explain_en: After a fronted 'Not only', the subject and auxiliary invert: did he meet.
explain_hi: आरंभ में 'Not only' के बाद subject और auxiliary उलट जाते हैं: did he meet।

prompt: ___ in a hurry, she overlooked a critical flaw.
explain_en: A participle clause ('Working in a hurry...') neatly gives the reason.
explain_hi: Participle clause ('Working in a hurry...') कारण को संक्षेप में बताता है।

prompt: The proposal was accepted, ___ with some reservations.
explain_en: 'Albeit' means 'although', concisely introducing a concession: albeit with reservations.
explain_hi: 'Albeit' का अर्थ 'although' है, जो संक्षेप में रियायत जोड़ता है: albeit with reservations।

prompt: The board failed to consider the long-term ___ of the decision.
explain_en: 'Ramifications' are the complex consequences of a decision.
explain_hi: 'Ramifications' किसी निर्णय के जटिल परिणाम होते हैं।

prompt: It was the missing encryption ___ caused the breach, not the weak password.
explain_en: A cleft sentence for emphasis: 'It was ... that ...' uses 'that'.
explain_hi: ज़ोर देने के लिए cleft sentence: 'It was ... that ...' में 'that' आता है।

prompt: Had we tested it earlier, we ___ the problem before launch.
explain_en: Inverted third conditional ('Had we tested...') pairs with 'would have caught'.
explain_hi: उलटा third conditional ('Had we tested...') 'would have caught' के साथ आता है।

prompt: The findings, ___ preliminary, point to a serious systemic weakness.
explain_en: 'Albeit preliminary' concedes a point in a compact, formal way.
explain_hi: 'Albeit preliminary' संक्षेप में औपचारिक रूप से रियायत देता है।

prompt: Her explanation was so ___ that even non-experts grasped the risk immediately.
explain_en: 'Lucid' means clear and easy to understand.
explain_hi: 'Lucid' का अर्थ है स्पष्ट और समझने में आसान।

prompt: Under no circumstances ___ the master key be shared over email.
explain_en: After a negative adverbial ('Under no circumstances') the auxiliary comes first: should the key.
explain_hi: नकारात्मक adverbial ('Under no circumstances') के बाद auxiliary पहले आता है: should the key।

prompt: The report hedged its conclusions, using phrases that ___ certainty rather than claiming it.
explain_en: Hedged writing 'implied' certainty softly rather than asserting it outright.
explain_hi: सावधान लेखन में certainty को खुलकर कहने के बजाय 'implied' किया जाता है।

prompt: Which phrasing hedges a claim most appropriately in a formal report?
options: This may, under certain conditions, be exploitable.
Maybe someone can hack this, who knows.
explain_en: Formal hedging uses cautious modals and conditions: 'may, under certain conditions, be exploitable.'
explain_hi: औपचारिक hedging में सतर्क modals और शर्तें आती हैं: 'may, under certain conditions, be exploitable.'

prompt: Only after the audit ___ how many systems were affected.
explain_en: A fronted 'Only after...' triggers inversion: did we realise.
explain_hi: आरंभ में 'Only after...' inversion लाता है: did we realise।

prompt: The vendor's response was evasive, seeking to ___ responsibility rather than accept it.
explain_en: 'Deflect' responsibility means to turn it away from oneself.
explain_hi: 'Deflect' responsibility का अर्थ है ज़िम्मेदारी को खुद से दूर करना।

prompt: The system, ___ design assumed a trusted network, is now exposed to the internet.
explain_en: 'Whose' shows possession for a thing here: the system whose design.
explain_hi: यहाँ किसी वस्तु के लिए स्वामित्व 'whose' से दिखता है: the system whose design।
